evidence: Tencent's two-stage shape+texture diffusion paper; official weights released Jan 2025 under Tencent Hunyuan 3D Community License (free download, commercial-use restrictions for large platforms); ~6GB VRAM minimum, SOTA open image-to-3D at release.
Main repo hosts inference code and checkpoints for Hunyuan3D 2.0 family (DiT 1.1B, Paint 1.3B, turbo/mini variants) with ComfyUI support; custom Tencent community license, fully self-hostable.
Model card lists license 'other' = Tencent Hunyuan community license; weights downloadable for self-hosting, turbo variants run ~10-30s per asset on consumer GPUs.
Adds production-ready PBR material generation to Hunyuan3D 2.0 pipeline; reports improved texture realism and geometry detail over 2.0 in paper benchmarks.
Fully open-sourced June 2025: new PBR model, VAE encoder, and all training code; custom Tencent Hunyuan 3D community license, weights on HF, self-hostable on consumer GPUs (~10GB+ VRAM recommended).
Tech report only: 10B-param LATTICE shape model with 4K PBR textures was released as hosted product; weights never open-sourced per repo issue thread, marking the open/closed boundary vs 2.1.
Microsoft's Structured Latent (SLAT) representation paper; unified 3D latent enables mesh, radiance field, and 3D Gaussian outputs from text or image at up to 3.1B params.
MIT-licensed code with downloadable weights on HF; self-hostable, needs ~16GB VRAM (image-large variant); widely considered top open image-to-3D quality tier.
1.2B-param image-to-3D checkpoint under MIT license; model card documents GLB mesh export pipeline and local inference requirements (~16GB VRAM).
Stability AI feed-forward model producing UV-unwrapped textured mesh in ~0.5s on 7GB VRAM; illumination disentanglement reduces baked lighting artifacts vs TripoSR.
Weights downloadable under Stability AI Community License (free for individuals and orgs <$1M revenue; paid enterprise license above); self-hostable on consumer GPUs.
Combines point-cloud regression with diffusion refinement for real-time editable single-image 3D; paper reports better geometry than SF3D at ~0.7s/image on A100.
Open weights under Stability AI Community License (free <$1M annual revenue); self-hostable, ~10GB VRAM, outputs textured mesh with editable point-cloud intermediate.
Apache-2.0 code and weights; sparse-view LRM generates mesh from single image in ~10s on consumer GPU; built on Zero123++ multiview + feed-forward reconstruction.
Paper documents sparse-view large reconstruction model trained on Objaverse; reports improved geometry and training efficiency over OpenLRM baselines (Chamfer/PSNR evals).
VAST-AI 1.5B rectified-flow transformer trained on 2M curated samples; claims state-of-the-art fidelity among open shape generators on GSO/Objaverse-XL evals.
MIT-licensed collaboration between Stability AI and Tripo; <0.5s draft mesh on consumer GPU (no CUDA strictly required); low-fidelity baseline vs newer diffusion models.
Feed-forward LRM-style reconstruction paper; reports faster inference than optimization methods with competitive quality on GSO and OmniObject3D benchmarks.
MIT-licensed code (LICENSE file verified); multi-view diffusion + ISOMER reconstruction yields high-fidelity textured mesh in ~30s; checkpoint terms separate from code license.
Paper reports higher geometric and texture fidelity than InstantMesh/CRM-era baselines via explicit normal-color consistency; weights released on HF for self-hosting.
Cross-domain diffusion generating multi-view color+normal maps from single image; code/weights on GitHub (xxlong0/Wonder3D) with research-oriented license; popular Zero123++-era baseline.
High-resolution multi-view diffusion (row-wise attention, 512px) feeding regression reconstruction; paper shows sharper geometry than Zero123++/Wonder3D; code released by HKUST/VAST team.
MIT license; ECCV 2024 feed-forward model producing textured mesh in ~10s on A800 using six orthographic views + Flexicubes; weights on HF (Zhengyi/CRM).
Convolutional Reconstruction Model paper; end-to-end textured mesh via triplane U-Net, reports ~80% better quality metrics than prior feed-forward baselines on GSO/ABO.
Apache-2.0 code but model weights are CC-BY-NC-4.0 (research only, no commercial use); open reimplementation of Adobe LRM, weights auto-downloaded from HF.
Foundational viewpoint-conditioned image diffusion (Columbia/Toyota); Zero123 weights released for research use; enabled most subsequent multiview-to-3D pipelines.
Apache-2.0 code; generates fixed 3x2 grid of consistent multi-view images from one input; v1.2 weights on HF used as backbone for InstantMesh-class pipelines.
UCSD single-image-to-mesh in ~45s using Zero123 views + SDF reconstruction; code released (One-2-3-45 GitHub org) for research use; quality below current DiT models.
MIT license; text/image-conditional model outputting implicit NeRF/SDF functions renderable as meshes; fast (~1 min) but visibly low-detail vs 2025 diffusion models; old baseline.
MIT license; point-cloud diffusion then SDF regression for meshing; paper positions it as speed/quality tradeoff baseline (minutes vs hours for DreamFusion).
MIT license, NeurIPS 2025; first compositional model generating multiple distinct 3D parts/objects in one shot; weights on HF, runs on consumer GPUs (~16GB VRAM).
MIT license, NeurIPS 2025; spatial sparse attention enables gigascale (1024^3) SDF generation trained on 8 GPUs; weights released, high-res geometry quality claims over Hunyuan3D/TRELLIS.
Apache-2.0 with full training code, weights, and 2M curated dataset pipeline; claims quality competitive with proprietary solutions; LoRA-adaptable texture module.
Apache-2.0 license, CVPR 2025; multi-instance diffusion generates compositional 3D scenes from single image; weights on HF (VAST-AI/MIDI-3D), self-hostable.
First open-source simulation-capable 3D world generation (text/image to explorable scene via 360 panorama + layered mesh); custom Tencent community license; heavy VRAM requirements.
MIT-licensed ComfyUI node pack wrapping 20+ open 3D models (TripoSR, CRM, InstantMesh, TRELLIS, Hunyuan3D) into one self-hosted pipeline; 3.8k stars.
Community ComfyUI wrapper for Hunyuan3D 2.x with custom rasterizer; enables local text/image-to-3D+texture workflows; inherits Tencent model license for weights.
First comprehensive text-to-3D benchmark (Tsinghua): multi-level prompts with automatic quality + alignment metrics validated against human judgments; benchmarks 10 methods.
